title: Hazel and the Machine
author: A. M. Yarrow
blurb: Yara Quintana, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
